proof: For each task, odd affine multiplier modulo 2^14 is invertible; 128 lanes × 128 loop steps enumerate i=0..16383 exactly once. CPU reference traverses x monotonically using inverse permutation, checking both sum and index-weighted sum. Regions are disjoint 64KiB intervals; there is no padding in data allocation.
time_window: One full measured consumption epoch: one Native grid or three independently submitted Green grids followed by joins. Per-task 64KiB; per-group and epoch unions are distinct. Not all data is asserted resident simultaneously.
